MY COMMENTS:
Suddenly in 2026, AIPAC, which formerly donated around 60% to Democrats, donated around 80% to Democrats. This shows that in Trump’s second term, when he is clearly owned 100% by Zionists and has had very effective control over his Party, AIPAC’s focus on buying Democrats in Congress is even higher than it formerly was. The only time when it previously was around 80% to Democrats was in 2018 in the middle of Trump’s 1st term . That was so because the Republican Party’s biggest donor in 2016, was Miriam and Sheldon Adelson, who were citizens of both America and Israel and gave the Republican Party $82,522,800. In that same year, all of AIPAC gave Republicans $1,564,277 . The American Government is controlled by billionaires, not by PACS. The billionaires try to hide their control over the U.S. Government, but it’s the reality.
